_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Cowfusion#001.src: A Human, eh? All the way out 'ere at the end of the canyon? Yer a tough one.
Cowfusion#001.dst: 人間か？峡谷の果てまで来るたぁ、タフな奴だな。
Cowfusion#001.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#002.src: Perhaps I can give yer some work, if yer are lookin' for it? Someone's been coming and nabbing my cows!
Cowfusion#002.dst: 仕事を探してるなら頼みがあるんだが？誰かが俺の牛をかっさらっていくんだ！
Cowfusion#002.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#003.src: 'an I know exactly who it is - that blasted cow scientist that lives in the lab just north of 'ere.
Cowfusion#003.dst: 犯人は分かってる。すぐ北の研究所に住んでる、あのいまいましい牛の科学者だ。
Cowfusion#003.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#004.src: Anyway, yer up for the job? Can't let 'im just keep stealing them forever!
Cowfusion#004.dst: で、引き受けてくれるか？盗まれっぱなしじゃたまらん！
Cowfusion#004.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#005.src: His cavern laboratory is just north from 'ere. Not too hard to find. Once yer there, get him to return my cows!
Cowfusion#005.dst: 奴の洞窟研究所はすぐ北だ。すぐ見つかるさ。着いたら牛を返させてくれ！
Cowfusion#005.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#006.src: There's one problem though. The door to the place is always shut, so you'll 'ave to find another way in.
Cowfusion#006.dst: ただ問題がある。あそこの扉はいつも閉まってるから、別の入り口を探さにゃならん。
Cowfusion#006.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#008.src: Find a way into the Laboratory
Cowfusion#008.dst: 研究所に入る方法を見つける

Cowfusion#009.src: Search the Laboratory for the missing cows
Cowfusion#009.dst: 研究所で行方不明の牛を探す

Cowfusion#010.src: Find a way to free the Cows.
Cowfusion#010.dst: 牛を解放する方法を見つける。

Cowfusion#012.dst: 何が起きたか突き止める

Cowfusion#014.dst: こりゃどういうこった？信じらんねえ、お前なのか？俺の娘っ子よ、戻ってくると信じてたぞ！
Cowfusion#014.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#015.dst: 町暮らしの人間を雇ってお前を連れ戻させようなんて考えてたとはな？ハッ！
Cowfusion#015.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#016.dst: よし、囲いに戻れ。ほれ、行け！
Cowfusion#016.speaker: Ranol

Cowfusion#017.dst: Ranol の農場から逃げ出す

Cowfusion#021.src: You're right, there is no password. Just seeing if you can understand me.
Cowfusion#021.dst: その通り、合言葉なんてない。言葉が通じるか試しただけさ。
Cowfusion#021.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#022.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#022.dst: つまりお前も虐げられし仲間か？農夫どもから自由になりたい？なら運がいいぞ。
Cowfusion#022.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#023.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#023.dst: 俺が手を貸そう。いや、「俺たち」がな。
Cowfusion#023.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#024.src: Our people have a secret hideout not far from here. It's located right under that barn just behind me.
Cowfusion#024.dst: 俺たちの秘密の隠れ家がこの近くにある。俺の後ろの納屋の真下だ。
Cowfusion#024.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#025.src: It may seem close, but unless you've been practicing your atheletics, you won't be able to get over these fences.
Cowfusion#025.dst: 近く見えるが、よほど体を鍛えてなきゃこの柵は越えられないぞ。
Cowfusion#025.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#026.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#026.dst: 囲いの真ん中の干し草が見えるか？あれを押したり引いたりしてうまく置けば、牛の体でも柵を乗り越えられるはずだ。
Cowfusion#026.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#027.src: The second pen might have a similar problem, but I'm sure you can figure that out yourself.
Cowfusion#027.dst: 二つ目の囲いも似たような問題があるかもしれんが、自分でなんとかできるだろう。
Cowfusion#027.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#031.src: What? What does that even mean? There isn't actually a password! Or did no one tell me that there was? Ah, nevermind, at least you can understand me.
Cowfusion#031.dst: は？どういう意味だ？合言葉なんて本当はないぞ！それとも俺だけ聞かされてないのか？まあいい、言葉は通じるな。
Cowfusion#031.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#032.src: You're one of us then, the oppressed? Want to break free from these farmers? Well aren't you in luck.
Cowfusion#032.dst: つまりお前も虐げられし仲間か？農夫どもから自由になりたい？なら運がいいぞ。
Cowfusion#032.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#033.src: I can help you with that. WE can help you with that.
Cowfusion#033.dst: 俺が手を貸そう。いや、「俺たち」がな。
Cowfusion#033.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#034.src: Our people have a secret hideout not far from here. It's located right under that barn just behind me.
Cowfusion#034.dst: 俺たちの秘密の隠れ家がこの近くにある。俺の後ろの納屋の真下だ。
Cowfusion#034.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#035.src: It may seem close, but unless you've been practicing your atheletics, you won't be able to get over these fences.
Cowfusion#035.dst: 近く見えるが、よほど体を鍛えてなきゃこの柵は越えられないぞ。
Cowfusion#035.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#036.src: See that haybale in the middle of our pen? I bet you could push and pull it into such a position that'd allow you to climb over the fence with your cow physique.
Cowfusion#036.dst: 囲いの真ん中の干し草が見えるか？あれを押したり引いたりしてうまく置けば、牛の体でも柵を乗り越えられるはずだ。
Cowfusion#036.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#037.src: The second pen might have a similar problem, but I'm sure you can figure that out yourself.
Cowfusion#037.dst: 二つ目の囲いも似たような問題があるかもしれんが、自分でなんとかできるだろう。
Cowfusion#037.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#039.src: Find and enter the Secret Cow Hideout
Cowfusion#039.dst: 秘密の牛の隠れ家を見つけて入る

Cowfusion#041.src: Oh, a new recruit? We weren't expecting anyone at this time. How'd you find your way in?
Cowfusion#041.dst: あら、新入り？この時間に来る予定の人はいないはずだけど。どうやって入ってきたの？
Cowfusion#041.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#042.src: Wait, you're different. Something's off about you. Like you've never been in a cow's body before.
Cowfusion#042.dst: 待って、あなた何か違う。どこか変よ。まるで牛の体に入ったことがないみたい。
Cowfusion#042.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#043.src: Oh. Oh, this is not good. Uhm, you should talk to the boss. He'll probably know what to do with you.
Cowfusion#043.dst: あ。ああ、これはまずいわ。えっと、ボスと話したほうがいいわね。どうすればいいか分かるはずよ。
Cowfusion#043.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#044.src: You'll find him in the big office at the very end of this facility. Just stick to the path and don't be nosey, okay?
Cowfusion#044.dst: この施設の一番奥の大きな事務室にいるわ。道なりに進んで、よそ見はしないでね？
Cowfusion#044.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#045.src: Find the one who's in charge of the hideout
Cowfusion#045.dst: 隠れ家の責任者を探す

Cowfusion#047.src: Whoop, alright! Don't want you going anywhere, buddy! Uh... What are you doing here, exactly...?
Cowfusion#047.dst: おっと、よし！どこにも行かせないよ、君！えっと…それで、ここで何をしてるのかな…？
Cowfusion#047.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#048.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#048.dst: 君が…なんだって？ええっ、そんなことありえるの？そんなことができる物なんて何も…
Cowfusion#048.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#049.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?
Cowfusion#049.dst: あっ！僕の研究所をこそこそ嗅ぎ回ってたんだな。それは…まあいい、その話は後だ。僕の機械に入ったの？
Cowfusion#049.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#050.src: It's not even meant to do that! Its purpose is to turn the exiles back into Wocs. So how does a Human become a cow...?
Cowfusion#050.dst: そんな機能はないはずなんだ！あれは追放者を Woc に戻すための物だ。なのにどうして人間が牛に…？
Cowfusion#050.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#051.src: Right, right, sorry. Here, uh- I'll try and get this cage down. Darn controls... Why did I design these so poorly?
Cowfusion#051.dst: そうだね、ごめん。えっと、この檻を降ろしてみるよ。操作盤め…なんでこんな下手な設計にしたんだ？
Cowfusion#051.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#052.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?
Cowfusion#052.dst: …で、どのレバーを押すか考えてる間に、君の話を聞かせてよ！最近何か面白いことあった？
Cowfusion#052.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#053.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#053.dst: 君は…君なのか？君だ！わあ、また会えて嬉しいよ！Wynn で一緒に暴れ回った日々から随分経つね！
Cowfusion#053.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#054.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#054.dst: これは最高だよ！ここを案内してあげられる！一緒に救い出した仲間を紹介するよ！なんていいタイミングなんだ。
Cowfusion#054.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#055.src: I just need to figure out which switch to pull... I think it's this one! Probably. I really need to label these things. Alright, here goes!
Cowfusion#055.dst: どのスイッチを引くか分かれば…たぶんこれだ！きっと。本当にラベルを貼らなきゃ。よし、いくぞ！
Cowfusion#055.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#057.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.
Cowfusion#057.dst: えっと…ハハ。面白いね。人間だと言っておいて、牛のふりか。
Cowfusion#057.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#058.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#058.dst: それは…いいよ。僕は今すごくストレスを抱えてるんだ。毎日毎日働き詰めでね。そんな態度はいらないんだよ！
Cowfusion#058.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#059.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#059.dst: そうだよ、そんな態度はいらない。君を奈落に送ってやる。僕の失敗作が…全部眠ってる場所にね。
Cowfusion#059.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#060.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#060.dst: …武器があるだろ。なんとかなるさ！僕の助けなんていらないよね！ほら、下の居心地を味わってこい！
Cowfusion#060.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#062.src: Okay. So you are just a regular cow. Not a Woc. Uh... Who let you in, little pal? I'm going to need to have to have a word about closing the doors...
Cowfusion#062.dst: そうか。君はただの普通の牛か。Woc じゃない。えっと…誰が入れたんだい、おちびさん？扉を閉めるよう言っておかないと…
Cowfusion#062.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#063.src: Well, this is... awkward. So, then... cow. What's it like being... a cow?
Cowfusion#063.dst: うーん、これは…気まずいな。じゃあ…牛くん。牛って…どんな気分？
Cowfusion#063.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#064.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#064.dst: 君が…なんだって？ええっ、そんなことありえるの？そんなことができる物なんて何も…
Cowfusion#064.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#065.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?

Cowfusion#065.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#066.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#067.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#068.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#069.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#069.dst: 君は…君なのか？君だ！わあ、また会えて嬉しいよ！Wynn で一緒に暴れ回った日々から随分経つね！
Cowfusion#069.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#070.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#070.dst: これは最高だよ！ここを案内してあげられる！一緒に救い出した仲間を紹介するよ！なんていいタイミングなんだ。
Cowfusion#070.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#071.dst: どのスイッチを引くか分かれば…たぶんこれだ！きっと。本当にラベルを貼らなきゃ。よし、いくぞ！
Cowfusion#071.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#073.dst: えっと…ハハ。面白いね。人間だと言っておいて、牛のふりか。
Cowfusion#073.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#074.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#074.dst: それは…いいよ。僕は今すごくストレスを抱えてるんだ。毎日毎日働き詰めでね。そんな態度はいらないんだよ！
Cowfusion#074.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#075.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#075.dst: そうだよ、そんな態度はいらない。君を奈落に送ってやる。僕の失敗作が…全部眠ってる場所にね。
Cowfusion#075.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#076.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#076.dst: …武器があるだろ。なんとかなるさ！僕の助けなんていらないよね！ほら、下の居心地を味わってこい！
Cowfusion#076.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#078.src: Right. Okay. Figure I'd best let you go free.
Cowfusion#078.dst: うん。そうか。逃がしてあげたほうがいいよね。
Cowfusion#078.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#079.src: ...Unless. Unless. Nobody's... nobody's looking. I could just send you to The Pit... Nobody would know.
Cowfusion#079.dst: …待てよ。誰も…誰も見てない。奈落に送っちゃえば…誰にも分からない。
Cowfusion#079.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#080.src: It's... easier this way. It's fine. Maybe you'll even- maybe you'll even make your way out. Good luck, little buddy.
Cowfusion#080.dst: こっちのほうが…楽だ。大丈夫。もしかしたら君も…自力で出てこられるかも。頑張ってね、おちびさん。
Cowfusion#080.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#083.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#083.dst: 焼却炉に落ちた？それで変異した牛の怪物を倒したって？
Cowfusion#083.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#084.src: ...Oh! You're the one Drale told us to look out for. Accidentally dropped into the Pit, huh?
Cowfusion#084.dst: …あっ！Drale が言ってた奴か。うっかり奈落に落とされたんだって？
Cowfusion#084.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#085.src: The boss said to apologize to ya for the inconvenience. We've all been workin' late hours recently... Some of us more than others.
Cowfusion#085.dst: ボスが迷惑かけて済まないってさ。最近はみんな夜遅くまで働いててな…人によっちゃ特にな。
Cowfusion#085.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#086.src: Anyhow, follow me. I'll take you back to him, and you can talk this out! You'll be back as a human in no time.
Cowfusion#086.dst: とにかくついてきな。ボスのところに連れてくから、話し合えばいい！すぐ人間に戻れるさ。
Cowfusion#086.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#087.src: So... yeah. That's Drale for you. Absentminded as ever. He said something about labeling his levers from now on, so I reckon that's a positive.
Cowfusion#087.dst: で…まあ。あれが Drale って奴さ。相変わらずうっかり者だ。今後はレバーにラベルを貼るって言ってたから、良い兆しかな。
Cowfusion#087.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#088.src: ...You're a good friend of the boss, right? Would you be able to put in a good word for us? Gerald and I have been down here for a while, and we'd like to get back to our normal positions.
Cowfusion#088.dst: …あんた、ボスの親友なんだろ？俺たちのことを口添えしてくれないか？Gerald と俺はここに長くいてな、元の持ち場に戻りたいんだ。
Cowfusion#088.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#089.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#089.dst: Drale は機嫌のいい日はいい奴なんだが、最近はそんな日が減っててな！例の…まるで無用な計画で毎晩遅くまで粘ってるんだ！
Cowfusion#089.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#090.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#090.dst: 手持ちの資材で新しい船を造ればいいのに、元の船を探し続けるって言い張るんだ！馬鹿げてるよ！
Cowfusion#090.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#091.src: Maybe you'll be able to get through to him, being his friend and all. We've all been stressed, and it's really just...
Cowfusion#091.dst: 友達のあんたなら話が通じるかもな。みんな参ってて、ほんとにもう…
Cowfusion#091.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#092.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#092.dst: 何の船かって？ああ、あんたは Woc じゃないもんな。実は俺たちの種族は元々…いや、その話はまた今度にしよう。
Cowfusion#092.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#093.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab. Drale will be glad to see you in one piece! He sounded worried for your safety.
Cowfusion#093.dst: 今はとにかく上の主研究所に戻ろう。無事な姿を見たら Drale も喜ぶさ！あんたの身を心配してたみたいだし。
Cowfusion#093.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#095.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#095.dst: あのパイプを上れば、運が良けりゃ Drale の目の前にポンと出られるさ。
Cowfusion#095.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#096.src: Remember what I told you! Try to put in a good word for us, yeah?
Cowfusion#096.dst: 言ったこと忘れるなよ！俺たちのこと口添えしてくれよな？
Cowfusion#096.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#097.src: If not, well... At least I tried. Let the record show I tried.
Cowfusion#097.dst: 駄目なら、まあ…少なくとも俺は頼んだ。それだけは覚えといてくれ。
Cowfusion#097.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#098.src: ...Alright! Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#098.dst: …よし！さあ行きな！会えてよかったよ。
Cowfusion#098.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#100.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#100.dst: 焼却炉に落ちた？それで変異した牛の怪物を倒したって？
Cowfusion#100.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#101.src: Yeah that checks out. So what happened to get you thrown down here?
Cowfusion#101.dst: ああ、それなら納得だ。で、何があってここに落とされたんだ？
Cowfusion#101.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#102.src: Oh, angered him by pretending to be a cow after already speaking? Yeah, I feel ya. When the boss is in a mood, anything you say could get you thrown down here.
Cowfusion#102.dst: もう喋ってたのに牛のふりして怒らせた？ああ、分かるよ。ボスの機嫌が悪いと、何言っても落とされるからな。
Cowfusion#102.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#103.src: Here, why don't you follow me? I'll take you back to him, you can straighten things out, and I'm sure you'll be back as a human in no time!
Cowfusion#103.dst: ほら、ついてきな。ボスのところに連れてくから、誤解を解けばいい。きっとすぐ人間に戻れるさ！
Cowfusion#103.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#104.src: So... yeah. Drale isn't the best at... conflict resolution. Catch him on a bad day, and he might just throw you in the Pit.
Cowfusion#104.dst: で…まあ。Drale は…揉め事の収め方が下手でな。機嫌の悪い日に当たると、奈落に放り込まれかねない。
Cowfusion#104.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#105.src: I got stationed down here for a week because I interrupted him during his daily yoga session.
Cowfusion#105.dst: 俺は毎日のヨガの最中に話しかけちまって、一週間ここに回されたんだ。
Cowfusion#105.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#106.src: Gerald, over there? He used to be in accounting. Until he forgot to carry the two one day, and... Well, here he is now.
Cowfusion#106.dst: あっちの Gerald？昔は経理だったんだ。ある日繰り上がりを忘れて…で、今はここにいる。
Cowfusion#106.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#107.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#107.dst: Drale は機嫌のいい日はいい奴なんだが、最近はそんな日が減っててな！例の…まるで無用な計画で毎晩遅くまで粘ってるんだ！
Cowfusion#107.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#108.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#108.dst: 手持ちの資材で新しい船を造ればいいのに、元の船を探し続けるって言い張るんだ！馬鹿げてるよ！
Cowfusion#108.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#109.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#109.dst: 何の船かって？ああ、あんたは Woc じゃないもんな。実は俺たちの種族は元々…いや、その話はまた今度にしよう。
Cowfusion#109.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#110.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab and hopefully Drale will be in a bit of a better mood!
Cowfusion#110.dst: 今はとにかく上の主研究所に戻ろう。Drale の機嫌が少しは直ってるといいな！
Cowfusion#110.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#112.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#112.dst: あのパイプを上れば、運が良けりゃ Drale の目の前にポンと出られるさ。
Cowfusion#112.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#113.src: If you try explaining the situation again I'm sure he'll be understanding.
Cowfusion#113.dst: もう一度事情を説明すれば、きっと分かってくれるさ。
Cowfusion#113.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#114.src: He usually is after he's had some time to cool off.
Cowfusion#114.dst: 少し頭を冷やせば、たいていそうなる。
Cowfusion#114.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#115.src: Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#115.dst: さあ行きな！会えてよかったよ。
Cowfusion#115.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#117.src: You fell into the incinerator? And defeated a mutant cow monster?
Cowfusion#117.dst: 焼却炉に落ちた？それで変異した牛の怪物を倒したって？
Cowfusion#117.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#118.src: Yeah that checks out. So what happened to get you thrown down here?
Cowfusion#118.dst: ああ、それなら納得だ。で、何があってここに落とされたんだ？
Cowfusion#118.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#119.src: Pretended to be a cow when you're actually a human? Must have caught him on a rough day to get thrown down for that. Usually he'd just let a cow go.
Cowfusion#119.dst: 本当は人間なのに牛のふり？そんなことで落とされるとは、よほど機嫌の悪い日だったんだな。いつもなら牛は逃がすのに。
Cowfusion#119.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#120.src: Well here, why don't you follow me? I'll take you back to him, you can straighten things out, and I'm sure you'll be back as a human in no time!
Cowfusion#120.dst: じゃあ、ついてきな。ボスのところに連れてくから、誤解を解けばいい。きっとすぐ人間に戻れるさ！
Cowfusion#120.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#121.src: So... yeah. That's Drale. Catch him on a bad day, and he might just throw you into the Pit.
Cowfusion#121.dst: で…まあ。あれが Drale さ。機嫌の悪い日に当たると、奈落に放り込まれかねない。
Cowfusion#121.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#122.src: I got stationed down here for a week because I interrupted him during his daily yoga session.
Cowfusion#122.dst: 俺は毎日のヨガの最中に話しかけちまって、一週間ここに回されたんだ。
Cowfusion#122.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#123.src: Gerald, over there? He used to be in accounting. Until he forgot to carry the two one day, and... Well, here he is now.
Cowfusion#123.dst: あっちの Gerald？昔は経理だったんだ。ある日繰り上がりを忘れて…で、今はここにいる。
Cowfusion#123.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#124.src: Drale's alright on a good day, but we've been running out of good days lately! He keeps pulling late hours on this... wholly unnecessary project!
Cowfusion#124.dst: Drale は機嫌のいい日はいい奴なんだが、最近はそんな日が減っててな！例の…まるで無用な計画で毎晩遅くまで粘ってるんだ！
Cowfusion#124.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#125.src: He insists we have to keep trying to find our original ship, instead of just building a new one with all the materials we have! It's ridiculous!
Cowfusion#125.dst: 手持ちの資材で新しい船を造ればいいのに、元の船を探し続けるって言い張るんだ！馬鹿げてるよ！
Cowfusion#125.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#126.src: What ship? Oh, of course, you're not a Woc. See, our race isn't actually from- you know, maybe that's a story for another time.
Cowfusion#126.dst: 何の船かって？ああ、あんたは Woc じゃないもんな。実は俺たちの種族は元々…いや、その話はまた今度にしよう。
Cowfusion#126.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#127.src: For now let's get you back up to the main lab and hopefully Drale will be in a bit of a better mood! Maybe mention the human thing this time, alright?
Cowfusion#127.dst: 今はとにかく上の主研究所に戻ろう。Drale の機嫌が直ってるといいな！今度は人間だってちゃんと言えよ？
Cowfusion#127.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#129.src: You head on up that pipe and with a bit of luck it'll plonk you out right in front of Drale.
Cowfusion#129.dst: あのパイプを上れば、運が良けりゃ Drale の目の前にポンと出られるさ。
Cowfusion#129.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#130.src: If you try explaining the situation again I'm sure he'll be understanding.
Cowfusion#130.dst: もう一度事情を説明すれば、きっと分かってくれるさ。
Cowfusion#130.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#131.src: He usually is after he's had some time to cool off.
Cowfusion#131.dst: 少し頭を冷やせば、たいていそうなる。
Cowfusion#131.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#132.src: Go on, off you go! It was lovely to meet you.
Cowfusion#132.dst: さあ行きな！会えてよかったよ。
Cowfusion#132.speaker: Worker

Cowfusion#134.src: Oh, this is- Oh! You're alive! I, ah- heh. Sorry about... all that. I really, really need to label these levers properly...
Cowfusion#134.dst: あっ、これは…あっ！生きてたんだ！僕、その…へへ。いろいろ…ごめん。本当に、本当にレバーにラベルを貼らないと…
Cowfusion#134.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#135.src: Right! Right. You'se seen... all that down there, then. I just hope you won't think less of me for it.
Cowfusion#135.dst: そう！そうだね。じゃあ下の…あれこれを見たんだね。それで僕を軽蔑しないでくれるといいけど。
Cowfusion#135.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#136.src: I can... I can tell you more about it later. I hope it wasn't too bad? Down there? You seen to have gotten out in one piece, so...
Cowfusion#136.dst: その話は…また後でするよ。下はそんなにひどくなかった？無事に出てこられたみたいだし…
Cowfusion#136.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#137.src: ...Oh. Right. Gosh, how long has it been since I-...
Cowfusion#137.dst: …あ。そうか。ああ、もうどれくらい…
Cowfusion#137.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#138.src: Okay. Alright, yes, I'll give them better positions. And I'll- I don't know. Apologize. Give them a bonus.
Cowfusion#138.dst: 分かった。うん、彼らにはいい持ち場を用意するよ。それと…どうしよう。謝って、ボーナスを出すか。
Cowfusion#138.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#139.src: It's been... hard, recently. We've been working to get back home, and I guess I just... Put too much of myself into that. It's fine! Don't- Don't worry about me.
Cowfusion#139.dst: 最近は…つらくてね。故郷に帰ろうと頑張ってて、たぶん僕は…自分を注ぎ込みすぎたんだ。大丈夫！僕の…僕のことは心配しないで。
Cowfusion#139.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#140.src: Oh. Right, your body! I can fix that! We just need to get back to the machine, and... Poof. You'll be back to normal!
Cowfusion#140.dst: あ。そうだ、君の体！直せるよ！機械のところに戻れば…ポン。元通りさ！
Cowfusion#140.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#141.src: ...I hope. Hey, being a cow isn't so bad! If- If it doesn't work, we can make you a home here...?
Cowfusion#141.dst: …たぶん。ねえ、牛も悪くないよ！もし…駄目だったら、ここに住めばいいし…？
Cowfusion#141.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#142.src: Uh... It'll work. It's always- always worked in the past! Heh...
Cowfusion#142.dst: えっと…うまくいくよ。今までずっと…ずっとうまくいったし！へへ…
Cowfusion#142.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#144.src: Uh... Hm. Maybe- Maybe being a cow is affecting your brain somehow... That can't be good.
Cowfusion#144.dst: えっと…うーん。もしかして…牛の体が脳に影響してるのかも…それはまずいな。
Cowfusion#144.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#145.src: We should get you back to human as quickly as possible. Come on, follow me.
Cowfusion#145.dst: 早く人間に戻さないと。さあ、ついてきて。
Cowfusion#145.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#146.src: ...This doesn't even mean anything! What am I supposed to do with-
Cowfusion#146.dst: …これじゃ何の意味もない！これをどうしろって…
Cowfusion#146.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#147.src: Oh! It's- It's you! Didn't I just...
Cowfusion#147.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#148.src: ...Um. This is... really awkward, haha. I'm... sorry?
Cowfusion#148.dst: …えっと。これは…すごく気まずいね、はは。僕…ごめんね？
Cowfusion#148.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#149.src: You're... the one who pretended to be a cow, right? I, uh... in my defense, I was very stressed. So I dropped you into the Pit.
Cowfusion#149.dst: 君は…牛のふりをした人だよね？僕、その…言い訳させて、すごくストレスが溜まってたんだ。だから奈落に落としちゃった。
Cowfusion#149.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#150.src: ...Anyway! What's- What's going on with your life? Anything interesting?
Cowfusion#150.dst: …とにかく！最近…最近どう？何か面白いことあった？
Cowfusion#150.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#151.src: Oh! Right. Getting back to normal.
Cowfusion#151.dst: あっ！そうか。元に戻るんだった。
Cowfusion#151.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#152.src: You said you stepped into my machine, right? We could try putting you in there a second time. What's the worst that could happen?
Cowfusion#152.dst: 僕の機械に入ったって言ったよね？もう一度入ってみようか。最悪、何が起きるっていうんだ？
Cowfusion#152.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#153.src: ...Uh. You stay as a cow. That's what. That's... fine. Let's just go and try it out.
Cowfusion#153.dst: …えっと。牛のままってことだね。うん。それは…いいよ。とにかく試しに行こう。
Cowfusion#153.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#154.src: ...This doesn't even mean anything! What am I supposed to do with-
Cowfusion#154.dst: …これじゃ何の意味もない！これをどうしろって…
Cowfusion#154.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#155.src: Oh! It's- It's you! Didn't I just...
Cowfusion#155.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#156.src: ...Um. This is... really awkward, haha. I'm... sorry?
Cowfusion#156.dst: …えっと。これは…すごく気まずいね、はは。僕…ごめんね？
Cowfusion#156.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#157.src: I am talking to a cow. Again. Why is this where my life has taken me.
Cowfusion#157.dst: また牛と話してる。僕の人生、どうしてこうなったんだ。
Cowfusion#157.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#158.src: So! What's... going on, little buddy? Any- any souvenirs? From the Pit...?
Cowfusion#158.dst: で！調子は…どうだい、おちびさん？何か…お土産は？奈落からの…？
Cowfusion#158.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#159.src: Oh, you- Oh. Right! Okay. I don't- I don't quite understand why you would pretend to be a cow. But alright!
Cowfusion#159.dst: あっ、君…あ。そうか！うん。なんで牛のふりなんかしたのか…よく分からないけど。まあいいや！
Cowfusion#159.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#160.src: So, uh... Human turned into a cow. Okay. How did you manage to get yourself stuck as a cow, anyway? I didn't think we had anything that could do that...
Cowfusion#160.dst: つまり、えっと…人間が牛になった。うん。それにしても、どうして牛のまま戻れなくなったの？そんなことができる物なんてないはずだけど…
Cowfusion#160.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#161.src: My machine. It's- It's not even supposed to do that! I designed it to turn exiles back into Wocs, how would it have...
Cowfusion#161.dst: 僕の機械か。そんな…そんな機能はないはずなのに！追放者を Woc に戻すために作ったのに、どうして…
Cowfusion#161.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#162.src: Great. Of course it'd have that issue, and just when I thought I...
Cowfusion#162.dst: 最高だよ。やっぱりそういう問題が出るんだ、しかも僕がやっと…
Cowfusion#162.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#163.src: Right. Right. Alright. We can work with this! Let's just take you back to that machine, put you in it, and see if it turns you back to normal!
Cowfusion#163.dst: よし。よし。分かった。なんとかなる！機械のところに戻って君を入れて、元に戻るか試してみよう！
Cowfusion#163.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#164.src: It'll work. Probably. I mean, I haven't ever tried it, so I can't really say for sure... Oh, yep, you're still here. Let's get moving.
Cowfusion#164.dst: うまくいくよ。たぶん。いや、試したことはないから、確かなことは言えないけど…あ、うん、まだいたね。行こうか。
Cowfusion#164.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#165.src: Uh... Hm. Maybe- Maybe being a cow is affecting your brain somehow... That can't be good.
Cowfusion#165.dst: えっと…うーん。もしかして…牛の体が脳に影響してるのかも…それはまずいな。
Cowfusion#165.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#166.src: We should get you back to human as quickly as possible. Come on, follow me.
Cowfusion#166.dst: 早く人間に戻さないと。さあ、ついてきて。
Cowfusion#166.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#168.src: Well, alright. Let's just- get you in my machine, I guess. It worked for the exiles, so maybe it will work for you...?
Cowfusion#168.dst: まあ、いいか。とりあえず…僕の機械に入れてみようかな。追放者には効いたし、君にも効くかも…？
Cowfusion#168.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#169.src: ...Don't look at me like that. Come on, let's get going.
Cowfusion#169.dst: …そんな目で見ないでよ。さあ、行こう。
Cowfusion#169.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#170.src: So... How have you been? It's been a while since our adventure at {p}, hasn't it?
Cowfusion#170.dst: で…元気だった？{p} での冒険から、ずいぶん経つよね？
Cowfusion#170.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#171.src: Well, you've been turned into a cow... Obviously... But besides that!
Cowfusion#171.dst: まあ、牛にされたのは…見れば分かるけど…それ以外で！
Cowfusion#171.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#172.src: Me? Well... heh. I've been doing pretty well, all thing considered. We've been gathering exiles from all over the province! Set up a city for us all while we work towards...
Cowfusion#172.dst: 僕？まあ…へへ。いろいろあったけど、元気にやってるよ。地方中から追放者を集めてるんだ！みんなの街を作って、目指してるのは…
Cowfusion#172.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#173.src: It's a long story. I can't tell you everything- not yet. But... All of us here, we don't belong here. We just want to go home.
Cowfusion#173.dst: 長い話なんだ。全部は話せない…まだね。でも…ここにいるみんな、ここの者じゃないんだ。ただ故郷に帰りたいだけなんだ。
Cowfusion#173.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#174.src: And- and maybe if we can find our ship again, we'll be able to prove that we're not irredeemable. That whatever we went through- that it won't define us.
Cowfusion#174.dst: それに…船をもう一度見つけられたら、僕らが救いようのない存在じゃないと証明できるかも。過去の経験で僕らは決まらないって。
Cowfusion#174.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#175.src: ...Heh. Don't- don't worry about it too much. For now, this place is enough of a safe haven for us. It'll have to be enough until we succeed.
Cowfusion#175.dst: …へへ。あまり…あまり気にしないで。今はここが僕らにとって十分な避難所なんだ。成功するまでは、それで足りるはずさ。
Cowfusion#175.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#176.src: We're so close. I can feel it. Just... Just a little while left to go.
Cowfusion#176.dst: もうすぐなんだ。感じるよ。あと…あと少しなんだ。
Cowfusion#176.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#177.src: Anyway, uh... Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#177.dst: とにかく、えっと…エレベーターはここだよ！乗って、研究所まで上がろう。
Cowfusion#177.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#178.src: The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
Cowfusion#178.dst: あ…あれ。えっと…何でもないよ。心配いらない。
Cowfusion#178.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#179.src: It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
Cowfusion#179.dst: ただの…整備区画に通じてるだけ。うん！ただの…整備区画。それだけ。
Cowfusion#179.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#180.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#180.dst: さあエレベーターへ！どうせ入るには鍵がいるし、僕はそんな物、絶対持ってないからね！
Cowfusion#180.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#181.src: ...You're worrying me, friend. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#181.dst: …心配になってきたよ、君。さあ、行こう。エレベーターに乗って、元に戻そう。
Cowfusion#181.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#182.src: So... Have you done anything interesting recently? Besides- getting turned into a cow. Obviously.
Cowfusion#182.dst: で…最近何か面白いことした？その…牛にされた以外で。もちろん。
Cowfusion#182.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#183.src: You're, uh... Probably wondering what this place is. Just a big city under some random guy's farm, right?
Cowfusion#183.dst: 君は、えっと…ここが何なのか気になってるよね。どこかの農場の下にある大きな街、って。
Cowfusion#183.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#184.src: It's... heh. We've been trying to gather as many of our people as we can. We exiles have to stick together, after all.
Cowfusion#184.dst: ここは…へへ。仲間をできるだけ集めようとしてるんだ。追放者同士、助け合わないとね。
Cowfusion#184.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#185.src: It's a long story. I'm not sure how much of it I really want to tell you, heh. Especially considering... Yeah.
Cowfusion#185.dst: 長い話なんだ。どこまで話したいか自分でも分からないよ、へへ。特に…うん。
Cowfusion#185.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#186.src: But. This place is a safe haven for us exiles. A place for us all to live until we achieve our goals.
Cowfusion#186.dst: でも。ここは僕ら追放者の避難所なんだ。目標を果たすまで、みんなで暮らす場所さ。
Cowfusion#186.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#187.src: And- hey! You've seen our secrets now! May as well let it be a safe haven for you as well, right? Heh.
Cowfusion#187.dst: それに…そうだ！君はもう僕らの秘密を見たんだ！君の避難所にもしちゃえばいいよね？へへ。
Cowfusion#187.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#188.src: Oh- the elevator. Here we are. Uh... Just head on in, little buddy? It'll take us up.
Cowfusion#188.dst: あ…エレベーターだ。着いたよ。えっと…乗ってくれる、おちびさん？上まで行けるから。
Cowfusion#188.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#189.src: The- oh. Uh... It's nothing. Nothing to worry about.
Cowfusion#189.dst: あ…あれ。えっと…何でもないよ。心配いらない。
Cowfusion#189.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#190.src: It just leads to... maintenance. Yep! Just- just maintenance. Nothing else.
Cowfusion#190.dst: ただの…整備区画に通じてるだけ。うん！ただの…整備区画。それだけ。
Cowfusion#190.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#191.src: Into the elevator now, come on! You need a key to get in anyway, and I definitely don't have one laying around!
Cowfusion#191.dst: さあエレベーターへ！どうせ入るには鍵がいるし、僕はそんな物、絶対持ってないからね！
Cowfusion#191.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#192.src: ...You're worrying me. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator, let's get you back to normal.
Cowfusion#192.dst: …心配になってきたよ。さあ、行こう。エレベーターに乗って、元に戻そう。
Cowfusion#192.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#193.dst: で…やあ、ちっちゃな…牛くん？
Cowfusion#193.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#194.src: Uh. Do you- do you understand what I'm saying?
Cowfusion#194.dst: えっと。君…僕の言葉、分かる？
Cowfusion#194.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#195.src: ...This is stupid. I'm talking to a cow. Of course you can't...
Cowfusion#195.dst: …馬鹿みたいだ。牛に話しかけてる。分かるわけ…
Cowfusion#195.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#197.src: Well I guess I could- talk at you. For a bit. If that's, heh, fine with you!
Cowfusion#197.dst: まあ、ちょっと…話を聞いてもらおうかな。君さえ、へへ、良ければ！
Cowfusion#197.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#198.src: It's been tough, recently. Working towards a goal I know is important, but still feels... out of reach.
Cowfusion#198.dst: 最近はつらくてね。大事だと分かってる目標に向かってるのに、どうしても…届かない気がする。
Cowfusion#198.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#199.src: And it doesn't seem like anybody else can see that! That this is important! They look at me like I'm going crazy, and-
Cowfusion#199.dst: しかも誰もそれを分かってくれないみたいで！これが大事だってことを！みんな僕がおかしくなったみたいな目で見て…
Cowfusion#199.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#200.src: I'm not. I know I'm not. We need to find the ship. If we don't, who knows what...
Cowfusion#200.dst: おかしくない。分かってる。船を見つけなきゃ。でないと、何が…
Cowfusion#200.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#201.src: Anyway! Here's the elevator! Just step on in, and we can head on up to the laboratory.
Cowfusion#201.dst: とにかく！エレベーターはここだよ！乗って、研究所まで上がろう。
Cowfusion#201.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#202.src: Hrrgh- You're- you're not a cow?! Why would you... I just said all that, and you could...
Cowfusion#202.dst: うぐっ…君、君は牛じゃないの？！なんで…あんなこと全部喋ったのに、君は…
Cowfusion#202.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#203.src: D-Don't worry about the door. It's... It's nothing. Maintenance. That- that's what it is.
Cowfusion#203.dst: と、扉のことは気にしないで。あれは…何でもない。整備区画。そ、そういうこと。
Cowfusion#203.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#204.src: Er... come on, into the elevator! You want to get back to normal, right? Besides, you'd need a key to get in there, and I don't know where you'd find one of those, haha!
Cowfusion#204.dst: えっと…さあ、エレベーターへ！元に戻りたいでしょ？それに、入るには鍵がいるし、どこで見つかるかなんて僕も知らないよ、はは！
Cowfusion#204.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#205.src: ...Moo. Yep. I agree. Come on, let's get going. Into the elevator.
Cowfusion#205.dst: …モー。うん。同感だ。さあ、行こう。エレベーターへ。
Cowfusion#205.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#206.src: So... here we are. The lab!
Cowfusion#206.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#207.src: Just... follow me, for now. The machine is this way.
Cowfusion#207.dst: とりあえず…ついてきて。機械はこっちだよ。
Cowfusion#207.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#208.src: There it is! If you step into the machine, real quick, it should... it should work!
Cowfusion#208.dst: あれだ！機械にさっと入ってくれれば…うまく…うまくいくはず！
Cowfusion#208.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#210.src: Look at you! As good as new!
Cowfusion#210.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#212.src: Heh... Well, there you are! Good as new! I hope...
Cowfusion#212.dst: へへ…ほら、戻った！新品同様！たぶん…
Cowfusion#212.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#213.src: And- to, uh, compensate you for... you know... Here! One liquid emerald. I feel terrible for how our reunion ended up going... I hope you won't hold it against me?
Cowfusion#213.dst: それと…その、お詫びに…ほら…これ！液体エメラルド一つ。こんな再会になって本当に申し訳ない…恨まないでくれるといいけど？
Cowfusion#213.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#214.src: Uh... I really should get back to work. But- hey! Feel free to visit whenever you want! You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
Cowfusion#214.dst: えっと…そろそろ仕事に戻らないと。でも…そうだ！いつでも遊びに来てよ！Ranol の農場の入り口から入れるから。
Cowfusion#214.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#215.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! That'd be nice.
Cowfusion#215.dst: 僕が最近何をしてるか、もっと話せるかも！それはいいね。
Cowfusion#215.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#216.src: There you are! Back to norm...-
Cowfusion#216.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#217.src: {u}?! What are you- that was you the whole time?! Why didn't you tell me!
Cowfusion#217.dst: {u}？！何を…ずっと君だったの？！なんで言ってくれなかったのさ！
Cowfusion#217.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#218.src: Oh gosh, this has been... An awful reunion. I can't believe I dropped you into the Pit...
Cowfusion#218.dst: ああもう、これは…ひどい再会だ。君を奈落に落としたなんて信じられない…
Cowfusion#218.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#219.src: I'm so sorry for- for all of that. You should have told me! Oh...
Cowfusion#219.dst: その…いろいろ本当にごめん。言ってくれればよかったのに！ああ…
Cowfusion#219.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#220.src: Okay, uh... Here, take this. As- as compensation for- for all of that.
Cowfusion#220.dst: よし、えっと…ほら、これ。その…いろいろのお詫びに。
Cowfusion#220.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#221.src: I... I need to get back to work. But- uh, if you ever want, feel free to visit sometime? You'll be able to use the entrance at Ranol's farm.
Cowfusion#221.dst: 僕…仕事に戻らないと。でも…その、よかったらいつでも遊びに来て？Ranol の農場の入り口から入れるから。
Cowfusion#221.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#222.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! Heh...
Cowfusion#222.dst: 僕が最近何をしてるか、もっと話せるかも！へへ…
Cowfusion#222.speaker: Drale
